#[repr(C)]
pub struct CpPixelT {
    pub r: u8,
    pub g: u8,
    pub b: u8,
    pub a: u8,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct CpImageT {
    pub w: i32,
    pub h: i32,
    pub pix: *mut CpPixelT,
}

pub fn premultiply(img: &mut CpImageT) {
    let w = img.w;
    let h = img.h;
    let stride = (w as usize).wrapping_mul(std::mem::size_of::<CpPixelT>());

    if w <= 0 || h <= 0 {
        return;
    }

    let data = img.pix as *mut u8;
    let total_bytes = stride.wrapping_mul(h as usize);

    let mut i = 0;
    while i < total_bytes {
        let a = data.wrapping_add(i + 3).read() as f32 / 255.0;
        let r = data.wrapping_add(i + 0).read() as f32 / 255.0;
        let g = data.wrapping_add(i + 1).read() as f32 / 255.0;
        let b = data.wrapping_add(i + 2).read() as f32 / 255.0;

        let r_mult = r * a;
        let g_mult = g * a;
        let b_mult = b * a;

        data.wrapping_add(i + 0).write((r_mult * 255.0) as u8);
        data.wrapping_add(i + 1).write((g_mult * 255.0) as u8);
        data.wrapping_add(i + 2).write((b_mult * 255.0) as u8);

        i = i.wrapping_add(std::mem::size_of::<CpPixelT>());
    }
}
